summary: Issue #18: the isolated clean-Profile smoke copied ambient settings.yaml and never selected the DSV4-FVE route, so it ran the ambient agent-default-model (qwen38-207/qwen38-flash-next) instead of the vLLM/PTC selection. Implemented a test-only line-oriented no-YAML helper replaceAgentDefaultModel that deterministically rewrites only the top-level agent-default-model provider/model inside the disposable copied settings (defaults RLM_LIVE_PROVIDER=vllm, RLM_LIVE_MODEL=DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, both overridable), plus an RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT portability seam that resolves the authoritative harness root and validates apps/cli/src/bin.ts before launch; the live M1E test now asserts headless status 0 with bounded stdout/stderr tails, preserves every existing clean-Profile assertion, and asserts ambient settings/.credentials.yaml byte-unchanged in finally. Strict TDD: offline M2 Issue#18 test RED 1/1 then GREEN 1/1; offline profile-smoke 1 pass plus 2 live-gated skip; pnpm test 113 (111 pass, 2 skip); typecheck/build/check:memory/diff-check pass. Live was attempted with bounded diagnostics: (A) pre-fix environment-layout RED where the legacy three-level REPO_ROOT mis-resolved to D:/Source in the external worktree and the launcher required tsx there (fixed with RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT pointing at the authoritative harness root); (B) provider deepseek -> headless exit 1 UNKNOWN_MODEL (pi-ai provider deepseek has no configured model) which is the live RED proving the wrong provider assumption; (C) authoritative provider vllm -> headless exit 1 NO_ADAPTER (no adapter registered for provider vllm; the UI provider-group label vllm is not a pi-ai-adapter-owned profile key). The live clean-Profile did not reach RLM_ACCEPT_OK, so no live PASS is claimed and Issue #18 stays open for the harness/settings-side model-profile gap.

steps: Added the focused offline contract test with a no-op stub and captured genuine RED 1/1: the copied settings text was returned unchanged, so the isolated run would keep the ambient qwen38 default instead of DSV4-FVE.

Implemented replaceAgentDefaultModel: detects the input EOL once, preserves unrelated lines byte-for-byte, rewrites exactly the two two-space-indented provider/model scalars inside the top-level agent-default-model block, and rejects a missing, duplicated or malformed block and unsafe scalars.

Wired the live M1E test: read ambient settings bytes, rewrite only the copied text, write the temp settings, copy the credentials exactly, validate the resolved harness root bin.ts before launch, assert headless status 0 with bounded stdout/stderr tails, keep every existing clean-Profile assertion, and in finally assert ambient settings/credentials byte-unchanged before cleanup.

Added the RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT portability seam, extended the offline test to prove override/default resolution without filesystem mutation (synthetic relative override resolves absolute; default stays the in-tree three-level parent), and updated README EN/ZH and architecture EN/ZH §9 to the explicit disposable-only vllm pin and optional overrides.

Ran offline gates: focused GREEN 1/1, offline profile-smoke 1 pass plus 2 skip, pnpm test 113 (111 pass, 2 skip), pnpm typecheck PASS, pnpm build PASS (lib/index.mjs 37.54 kB), pnpm check:memory PASS, git diff --check PASS.

Ran live three times with bounded diagnostics (layout RED tsx/D:/Source, deepseek UNKNOWN_MODEL live RED, vllm NO_ADAPTER); after the coordinator UI readback the provider default was corrected from deepseek to vllm, the model stayed DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, and the remaining harness/settings-side blocker was recorded without switching contract or claiming live PASS.

limitations: The live clean-Profile smoke did not reach RLM_ACCEPT_OK: the headless CLI reports UNKNOWN_MODEL for provider deepseek and NO_ADAPTER for provider vllm in this ambient home; the UI provider-group label vllm does not map to a pi-ai-adapter-owned profile key (harness packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts around NO_ADAPTER), and the ambient provider profiles carry no configured DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp descriptor. Resolving it requires harness/settings-side configuration outside this task write scope; Issue #18 remains open.
External-worktree live runs must set RLM_DSH_REPO_ROOT to the authoritative harness root; without it the legacy three-level default mis-resolves and the launcher requires tsx at the wrong root.
No secrets, credentials, environment values, endpoints, headers or Session content were logged; all diagnostics are bounded and non-secret.
No live PASS is claimed; offline RED/GREEN plus gates are implementer-run except where explicitly marked coordinator-supplied.
